note: Scouted 2026-08-31 while opening ranked zero cities and NOT published. Every tree the national MASAF register holds inside the comune of Taormina stands in the grounds of one private hotel, which hard rule 10 blocks. Kept so nobody re-runs this hunt.

leads.name: Fico magnolioide di Villa Puglisi, Riposto
leads.why: MASAF sheet 01/H325/CT/19: 11 metres round and 18 metres tall, in Villa Puglisi at Riposto, 15.7 km from Taormina. Public villa gardens by the name, so this one probably passes; it is the only publishable tree found near Taormina and one tree cannot carry a page unless it is itself the destination. Would work as a Catania-area entry, or with Riposto as its own place. [SKIPPED 2026-09-01 by the write pass: single register source (MASAF), and it has no home yet: 15.7km from Taormina with no place of its own created, so it needs a place decision (Catania-area entry, or a new Riposto page) before it could ship, not just a story. not shippable this pass.]

leads.name: Castagno di Puntalazzo, Mascali
leads.why: Regional register 02/F004/CT/19 (D.D.G. n. 2870 of 14/10/2025): 1010 cm girth, 12 m, listed with the Castagno della Nave in Oct 2025 (cataniatoday 2025-10-28; etnanatura). Via Monteleonoti / via Petralia, Puntalazzo (Mascali), 1.4 km from the Cento Cavalli. A conference report says it is an isolated tree in private land at the edge of a vineyard; no source says it can be seen from a public road or visited. Register coordinate only (DMS 37 44 52.10 N 15 08 39.62 E), no GPS fix, no photo. Access unclear plus approximate pin: no photo or exact pin in reach. Etna east page candidate if a landowner or comune says it is viewable from the road.

leads.name: Castagno di Tramazzi, Sant'Alfio
leads.why: MASAF/regional 04/I216/CT/19: 860 cm girth, 16 m, multi-stem from one stool, 1015 m. etnanatura (Associazione Trucioli) says it is inside private property on the Magazzeni to Bocche di Santoro path; a second 6.4 m chestnut stands a few tens of metres along the farm track. Blocked on access for now (hard rule 10 does not allow private land with no stated public view). Pin is a register coordinate only.

leads.name: Fico magnolioide di Villa Puglisi, Riposto (second look 2026-11-02)
leads.why: Still a lead: Via di Circumvallazione 26, Riposto; register 11 m girth, 18 m, D.D.G. n. 108 of 16/02/2021; searches found no page saying whether the villa grounds are open to the public or when. Ask the Comune di Riposto.

leads.name: Cipresso at Casa Cuseni area, Taormina
leads.why: Regional sheet 04/L042/ME/19 second entry (D.D.G. n. 261 of 13/03/2024), Cupressus sempervirens, 50 cm girth and 10 m as printed, 250 m altitude, 'historic, cultural, religious value'. The printed coordinate (37 51 10.71 N 15 16 57.30 E) falls beside Casa Cuseni (a guest house, Via Leonardo da Vinci, Villagonia). Figures look corrupt or the tree is small; no source found; probably private. Not shippable.

leads.name: Leccio di Contrada Giuliana, Mascali
leads.why: Regional sheet 03/F004/CT/19 (D.D.G. n. 2917 of 16/10/2025): Quercus ilex, 254 cm girth, 10 m, 936 m, 'dimensions, form'. Register coordinate only; small for its species, no source found about access or a visit. Not researched further.

leads.name: Other Etna trees on the regional list, unvisited
leads.why: Linguaglossa Pino laricio at Pernicana (01/E602/CT/19, 600 cm, 24 m, 1250 m, 37.80735 14.95082); Milo Cerro at Monte Fontana (01/F214/CT/19, 560 cm, 1210 m); Milo beech group at Giarrita (03/F214/CT/19, 670 to 720 cm, 1430 m); Zafferana beech at Acquarocca degli Zappini (02/M139/CT/19, 630 cm, 1522 m) and Pioppo tremolo at Monte Pomiciaro (310 cm). Mountain forest, register coordinates only, hours from Taormina by car; not researched.

leads.name: Taormina Villa Comunale (Parco Duchi di Cesaro, Trevelyan garden)
leads.why: Public garden (donated to the comune 1922/23), old olives, carobs, almonds, araucaria and a 'monumental ficus' mentioned by APGI and tourist guides, but no source names or measures an individual tree and none is on the national or regional register. Nothing to pin. A photo or an OSM tree node of a single named specimen would be needed.

blocked.name: Albero del drago, Taormina
blocked.why: MASAF 01/L042/ME/19, Dracaena draco, 2 m round and 8 m tall, at 37.850536 / 15.281122. The register's own locality field says Hotel Excelsior Palace. Private hotel grounds: hard rule 10, a reception desk to talk past is a no.

blocked.name: Carrubo, Taormina
blocked.why: MASAF 03/L042/ME/19, Ceratonia siliqua, 8 metres round, a remarkable carob by any standard. Same hotel grounds. Blocked on access, not on quality.

blocked.name: Fico magnolioide group, Taormina
blocked.why: MASAF 02/L042/ME/19, a homogeneous group of Ficus macrophylla at the same hotel. Blocked on access, and a group would also need to pass the collectible-point test.

blocked.name: Cipressi comuni, Taormina, two trees
blocked.why: MASAF 04 and 05/L042/ME/19, Cupressus sempervirens, both 2 m round and 30 m tall. Same hotel grounds.
